ev.q: an American animated television series produced by Fred Wolf Films
based on the comic book characters created by Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird
battle the Shredder, Krang, and numerous other villains and criminals
the eponymous Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and their allies
the show began its full-time run on October 1, 1988, and ended on November 2, 1996
criticized by various groups for its violent content and commercialism
to make it more suitable for children and families
